dialogue.origin: こんにちは、相談員です。今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.content: Hello, I'm a counselor. What brings you here today?

dialogue.origin: はい、色んなことがあって、友達が作れなかったのですが、SNSでやっと友達グループに入れました。
dialogue.content: Yes, a lot has happened and I hadn't been able to make friends, but I finally joined a friend group through social media.

dialogue.origin: カラオケとかも行ける様になりました。
dialogue.content: I've even been able to go to karaoke and things like that with them.

dialogue.origin: でも、最近、
dialogue.content: But recently...

dialogue.origin: すみません、年代と性別教えて頂けますか
dialogue.content: Excuse me, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.origin: 22歳、女です
dialogue.content: I'm 22, female.

dialogue.origin: その中の1人が同棲することになりあまり出掛けられなくなったと言って来たのですが、
dialogue.content: One of them said she's moving in with her partner and won't be able to go out much anymore, and...

dialogue.origin: はい、そうなんですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 自分の時間が無くなったとか、大変だとか、愚痴ばかり吐くのです。
dialogue.content: She just keeps complaining, saying she has no time for herself, that it's so hard, and so on.

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: そんな人とは離れたいのですが、それは、グループから出ることになるし、
dialogue.content: I want to distance myself from that person, but that would mean leaving the group,

dialogue.origin: せっかく繋がれたのに
dialogue.content: and I only just managed to connect with them.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: でも、愚痴なんか聞きたくないし、
dialogue.content: But I don't want to hear her complaints,

dialogue.origin: 共感も出来ません
dialogue.content: and I can't empathize with her either.

dialogue.origin: 私がおかしいのかなと思って
dialogue.content: It makes me wonder if there's something wrong with me.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、
dialogue.content: Mm-hm,

dialogue.origin: やっと、グループラインでの友達、カラオケにも行けるように、なって来たのに
dialogue.content: So you've finally made friends in a group chat, and you've even been able to go to karaoke with them,

dialogue.origin: そのなかの友達が愚痴ばかり言って来るのですね、
dialogue.content: and yet one of those friends is just complaining to you all the time.

dialogue.origin: どう考えたら良いですか？
dialogue.content: How should I think about this?

dialogue.origin: 本当に困ってしまいますよね
dialogue.content: That must be really troubling for you.

dialogue.origin: 腹が立ちます
dialogue.content: It makes me angry.

dialogue.origin: でも、不幸比べなんて嫌だし
dialogue.content: But I hate the idea of comparing who has it worse.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。もう少し、詳しく教えて頂きたいので、質問しても、よろしいでしょうか
dialogue.content: I understand. I'd like to understand the situation in a little more detail, so may I ask you a few questions?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: グループは、何人位なんでしょうか？
dialogue.content: About how many people are in the group?

dialogue.origin: 12人かな
dialogue.content: Around twelve, I think.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 皆さん、年代は同じぐらいなんでしょうか
dialogue.content: Is everyone around the same age?

dialogue.origin: 色々ですね、SNSでの繋がりなので、
dialogue.content: It's a mix, since we connected through social media.

dialogue.origin: なるほど
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: カラオケに行く時間帯はいつ頃行かれるのですか
dialogue.content: What time of day do you usually go to karaoke?

dialogue.origin: みんなで、最低3人くらいの時間が合えばで、決まっているわけではありません。
dialogue.content: It's not a set time. We just go whenever at least three of our schedules line up.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、週に何回位、行かれるのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Mm-hm, and about how many times a week do you go?

dialogue.origin: それも、週に1回だったり、月に2回だったりです。
dialogue.content: That varies too. Sometimes it's once a week, and other times it's twice a month.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。折角、みんなと楽しくやろうと、思っているのに
dialogue.content: I see. And you're just trying to have a good time with everyone, and yet...

dialogue.origin: チャットを見るのも嫌になります。
dialogue.content: It's getting to the point where I don't even want to look at the chat.

dialogue.origin: 読んでないのもおかしく思われるし、
dialogue.content: But I feel like people will think it's strange if I don't read it,

dialogue.origin: うんうん、そうですよね。
dialogue.content: Mm-hm, that makes sense.

dialogue.origin: 愚痴ばかり聞きたくないですよね
dialogue.content: You don't want to have to listen to constant complaining, right?

dialogue.origin: チャットも見たく無くなりますよね
dialogue.content: It makes you not even want to look at the chat.

dialogue.origin: そんなことでー！と思ってしまいます。でも、皆んなは適当に共感のフリをしている。
dialogue.content: I find myself thinking, "Over something like that?!" But everyone else just casually pretends to sympathize.

dialogue.origin: 私には、無理
dialogue.content: I can't do that.

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: SNSでの知り合いなので、最初は相手の気持ちも分からないですものね
dialogue.content: Since you all met on social media, it must be hard to understand each other's feelings at first.

dialogue.origin: 忙しいなら、グループをでてくれれば良いけど、そんな事は言えない
dialogue.content: If she's that busy, I wish she'd just leave the group, but of course I can't say that.

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: なら、私がやめるのかなと思うけど、
dialogue.content: So then I wonder if I should be the one to leave, but...

dialogue.origin: やっと友達が出来たのに
dialogue.content: I only just finally made some friends.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。貴方は、皆さんと一生懸命に併せようと努力しています
dialogue.content: I understand. You're trying so hard to fit in with everyone.

dialogue.origin: つまらない愚痴を吐く人とは合わせられない
dialogue.content: I can't get along with someone who just spouts pointless complaints.

dialogue.origin: 小さい時から家事を任されていたから、友達を作る時間が無かったんです。
dialogue.content: I've been in charge of the housework since I was a child, so I never had time to make friends.

dialogue.origin: やっと家を出て、少し自分の時間が作れて、やっと出来た仲間なんです。
dialogue.content: I finally moved out, made a little time for myself, and these are the friends I finally made.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。小さい頃から家事のお手伝いをされて来たのですね。あなたは、とてもえらいかたです。折角、出来た友達だから大事に考えておられるのですね
dialogue.content: I see. So you've been helping with housework since you were a child. You are a very admirable person. That must be why you cherish the friends you've finally made so much.

dialogue.origin: 今は、実家を離れて、やっと自由になれて、これから自分の時間を大切にしたいと、お考えなのですね
dialogue.content: Now that you've left your parents' home, you're finally free, and you want to cherish your own time from now on.

dialogue.origin: やっと出来た、お友達なので、グループも大事にしたい。
dialogue.content: And since these are friends you've finally made, you want to cherish the group as well.

dialogue.origin: 今も祖母の介護と家事で実家には通っています。それをする事が条件で家を出る事が出来ました。
dialogue.content: I still go to my parents' house to care for my grandmother and do housework. Being responsible for that was the condition for me being able to move out.

dialogue.origin: 祖母の介護まで、なんて優しい方なのでしょう
dialogue.content: You're even caring for your grandmother... you are such a kind person.

dialogue.origin: 私の義務なんです
dialogue.content: It's my duty.

dialogue.origin: それでは、本当に時間が取れませんよね。
dialogue.content: In that case, you really must not have much time for yourself.

dialogue.origin: でも、すごいですね。嫌嫌シテイルノデハナク、義務感とシテイルノデハナクとらえているあなたは、素晴らしいです
dialogue.content: But that's amazing. The way you see it not as something you do reluctantly, but as your duty, is wonderful.

dialogue.origin: SNSができるようになって、社会勉強してます（笑）
dialogue.content: Since I started using social media, I've been learning about the world (laughs).

dialogue.origin: すみません、タイピングミスです。
dialogue.content: I'm sorry, that was a typo.

dialogue.origin: はい意味が良くわかりませんでした
dialogue.content: Yes, I didn't quite understand what you meant.

dialogue.origin: 義務感としてとらえている貴方は、素晴らしいです
dialogue.content: The way you see it as your duty is wonderful.

dialogue.origin: わかりました！
dialogue.content: I see!

dialogue.origin: 私だったら、一週間も持ちません
dialogue.content: If it were me, I wouldn't last a week.

dialogue.origin: 義務感は重いですけど
dialogue.content: This sense of duty is a heavy burden, though.

dialogue.origin: でも、凄い❗
dialogue.content: But still, that's amazing!

dialogue.origin: 祖母が育ててくれたようなものだから、私の役目だと言われます。
dialogue.content: My grandmother practically raised me, so I'm told it's my role.

dialogue.origin: まあ、そう思ってもいますけど。
dialogue.content: Well, I suppose I think that way too.

dialogue.origin: だから、大変なこと吐き始めたらキリがないです。
dialogue.content: That's why if I started venting about my own hardships, there would be no end to it.

dialogue.origin: 不幸比べは絶対嫌です。
dialogue.content: I absolutely hate comparing misfortunes.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、そうなんですね。そんななかで、貴女は、愚痴多いかたのことも、考えておられてしんけいがやすまならいですよね
dialogue.content: I see, so that's how it is. And amidst all that, you're also worrying about this person who complains a lot. You must not get any peace of mind.

dialogue.origin: 彼女とは縁を切りたい。でも仲間は失いたく無い。
dialogue.content: I want to cut ties with her. But I don't want to lose the group.

dialogue.origin: とても、仲間を大切に思っているんですね
dialogue.content: You really treasure your friends, don't you?

dialogue.origin: その事は、他の仲間には、お話をして有りますか
dialogue.content: Have you spoken to your other friends about this?

dialogue.origin: 嫌われたく無いから言ってません。
dialogue.content: I haven't said anything because I don't want to be disliked.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 雰囲気悪くなったら嫌だし。
dialogue.content: And I'd hate for the atmosphere to turn sour.

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: 嫌でもその友達に寄り添わなきゃ駄目ですか？
dialogue.content: Do I have to sympathize with that friend even if I don't want to?

dialogue.origin: 出来ない私がおかしいですか？
dialogue.content: Is there something wrong with me for not being able to?

dialogue.origin: 友達グループは初めてなので不安です。
dialogue.content: This is my first time in a friend group, so I'm anxious.

dialogue.origin: 何かよい方法が見つかると安心しますよね
dialogue.content: It would be a relief to find a good solution, wouldn't it?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: きっと、しっかりされている貴女に愚直を聞いてほしいのかも知れませんね
dialogue.content: Perhaps she wants you, since you seem so dependable, to listen to her complaints.

dialogue.origin: グループチャットなので、特に私には無いと思います。
dialogue.content: It's a group chat, so I don't think it's directed at me specifically.

dialogue.origin: みんなに聞いて欲しいのですね。
dialogue.content: So she wants everyone to listen.

dialogue.origin: 私はしっかりなんかして無いし、
dialogue.content: I'm not dependable or anything,

dialogue.origin: 皆んなに投げかけてます
dialogue.content: she's just throwing it out there for everyone.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。皆さんで、ちえをだしあって、みんなが楽しく出来るようになると、いいですよね
dialogue.content: That's right. It would be great if everyone could put their heads together and find a way for everyone to have fun.

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: Yes, it would.

dialogue.origin: 折角のグループですので、これからも、大切にしていつてくださいね
dialogue.content: It's a precious group you've found, so please continue to cherish it.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: お話を沢山お聞きしたいのですが、そろそろお時間ですので、今日はこれで、終了となりますが、でしょうか
dialogue.content: I'd love to hear more, but we're almost out of time, so shall we wrap things up for today?

dialogue.origin: わかりました。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: I understand. Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: 今日は来て下さって有り難うございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you for coming in today.

dialogue.origin: これで、終了させて頂きます。合掌
dialogue.content: This concludes our session.

topic.sub: 友人とのコミュニケーション問題
